patterns.name: AI Use Case Portfolio Management
patterns.shortDescription: AI strategy becomes executable only when use cases are managed as a portfolio with explicit stages, value-at-risk, attribution methodology, kill decisions, and investment concentration instead of as scattered experiments.
patterns.longDescription:
Applies to enterprises running multiple AI initiatives across functions where leadership needs a single view of stage, value, investment allocation, duplication risk, and graduation discipline.

## Summary
The portfolio pattern is the enterprise mechanism that turns AI ambition into deliberate investment choices. The source frames it as the upstream discipline that gives governance focus, modernization demand, and vendor selection purpose by forcing use cases through stage gates with named owners, value hypotheses, and explicit continue-or-kill decisions.

## When to apply
Use this pattern when executives cannot produce an authoritative use-case count, POCs rarely graduate, multiple teams pursue similar initiatives in parallel, or AI strategy is still described as themes rather than as an operating portfolio.

## How it works
The core interventions are a named portfolio owner, stage-gate discipline, an outcome-attribution spine, a recurring kill-decision cadence, investment concentration targets, direct linkage from portfolio demand into modernization work, discovery of shadow use cases, and a portfolio dashboard that makes additions, advancements, kills, and value-at-risk visible.

## Variations
The pattern is cross-industry, but the review cadence and attribution methods change by use-case type. Some organizations start with spreadsheets or workflow tools, while more mature estates add dedicated portfolio or governance tooling, but the underlying management pattern stays the same.

## Pitfalls
The source is explicit about common failures: keeping use cases in permanent innovation mode, faking attribution, avoiding kill decisions, letting dashboards become theater, overloading strategy themes without execution choices, and tolerating duplicate work across teams.

## Instances
Concrete instances in the source are the eight named interventions that take a portfolio from inventory void to managed investment discipline. The pattern is also directly upstream of governance, vendor rationalization, and data-modernization prioritization.

patterns.name: Demand Forecasting & Inventory AI
patterns.shortDescription: Retail forecast modernization pays off when probabilistic, hierarchical, causal forecasting is paired with planner-operating-model redesign and downstream consumption governance rather than dropped into a legacy override culture.
patterns.longDescription:
Applies to retail planning and supply-chain environments where inventory days are growing, in-stocks and overstocks coexist, planners override models heavily, and promotional or new-product demand is still handled by heuristics.

## Summary
This pattern treats the forecast as the most leveraged number in retail operations. The source ties working capital, in-stock performance, markdowns, waste, and vendor planning back to whether the retailer has moved from category-level moving averages and planner overrides toward probabilistic, causal, hierarchical demand intelligence.

## When to apply
Use this pattern when SKU-store accuracy is plateaued, safety stock keeps rising, promotional lift is adjusted manually, new product forecasts depend on planner analogy, or fresh categories are accepting waste as unavoidable.

## How it works
The modernization program spans platform choice, causal feature libraries, probabilistic and hierarchical forecasting, promotional lift modeling, new-product forecasting, planner-role redesign, fresh optimization, and governance over how downstream replenishment, allocation, labor, and finance consume the demand signal.

## Variations
Subsector matters. Grocery and fresh require tighter shrink and perishability handling, while mass and specialty lean harder into promotions, assortment, and omnichannel substitution. The same pattern can be delivered on modern platforms or custom ML stacks when data and workflow discipline exist.

## Pitfalls
The source repeatedly calls out category-level accuracy theater, unguided planner overrides, safety-stock inflation as a substitute for model quality, disconnected promotional planning, and treating forecast fragmentation across functions as normal.

## Instances
Concrete instances in the source are the eight named trigger signals, from forecast-accuracy plateau through fresh-category waste and event/weather insensitivity.

patterns.name: Owned Brand Margin Recovery
patterns.shortDescription: Owned brand is a structural margin and differentiation lever that only compounds when SKU rationalization, sourcing, pricing, assortment, and NPD are run as an integrated analytics-backed program rather than as a lightly staffed line extension.
patterns.longDescription:
Applies to grocery, mass, and specialty retailers with meaningful private-label exposure, penetration gaps versus peers, underpowered analytics, or static pricing and sourcing practices.

## Summary
The source frames owned brand as the most underexploited margin-recovery opportunity in traditional retail. AI matters because it turns owned brand from a merchandising intuition play into an integrated operating program spanning SKU-level economics, supplier leverage, elasticity-aware pricing, trend detection, and launch acceleration.

## When to apply
Use this pattern when owned-brand penetration trails peers, margin dollars are flat, velocity is concentrated in a small subset of SKUs, pricing still follows fixed discounts to national brands, or category teams cannot produce same-day SKU-level P&L views.

## How it works
The integrated program starts with executive elevation of owned brand, then moves through SKU rationalization, cost-of-goods intelligence, assortment and pricing optimization, NPD acceleration, and stronger analytics support. The goal is to redirect shelf, spend, and talent toward the SKUs and categories where private label can widen margin and differentiation together.

## Variations
The pattern plays differently across grocery, mass, and specialty retail depending on assortment breadth, supplier structure, and consumer quality perception. Some retailers start with penetration recovery, while others start with pricing or sourcing because penetration is already mature.

## Pitfalls
The source warns against treating owned brand as an afterthought, relying on inherited national-brand pricing logic, leaving sourcing relationships static for years, and accepting low analytics coverage that forces category leaders to decide without SKU-level economics.

## Instances
Concrete instances in the source are the eight detection signals covering penetration gaps, margin-flatline, SKU velocity skew, sourcing stasis, static pricing, low NPD velocity, weak analytics support, and missing SKU-level P&L.

patterns.name: 340B economics sourcing control for healthcare bpo supply chain doctrine
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when vendor scope changed after modernization but the statement of work did not in healthcare bpo supply chain doctrine. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when vendor scope changed after modernization but the statement of work did not in healthcare bpo supply chain doctrine. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

A healthcare CPO treats supply-chain value as contract economics plus clinical adoption plus utilization control; price variance alone is not a savings claim. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when vendor scope changed after modernization but the statement of work did not and the category is 340B economics with manufacturer direct or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.

When Academic Medical Center Contract Analysis Human Override Ambiguity appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is deployment-site validation.

patterns.name: Account governance sourcing control for vendor-specific deep dives
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when vendor scope changed after modernization but the statement of work did not in vendor-specific deep dives. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when vendor scope changed after modernization but the statement of work did not in vendor-specific deep dives. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

Vendor deep dives must separate what is public capability, what is contract-specific evidence, and what is account-team behavior observed by the health system. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when vendor scope changed after modernization but the statement of work did not and the category is account governance with cyber managed-services firm or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

It does not apply to a read-only executive dashboard pilot with no behavior-change objective.

Keep the source-of-record boundary explicit: PSS, revenue management, crew, MRO, loyalty, and flight operations systems remains authoritative unless the charter says otherwise. Build the lakehouse around governed extracts, medallion transformation, and FAA, IATA, PCI, privacy, residency, safety-critical lineage, and operational reconciliation.
patterns.longDescription:
PSS, revenue management, crew, MRO, loyalty, and flight operations systems appears in the inventory as both source system and reporting dependency. Keep the source-of-record boundary explicit: PSS, revenue management, crew, MRO, loyalty, and flight operations systems remains authoritative unless the charter says otherwise. Build the lakehouse around governed extracts, medallion transformation, and FAA, IATA, PCI, privacy, residency, safety-critical lineage, and operational reconciliation.

Keep the source-of-record boundary explicit: PSS, revenue management, crew, MRO, loyalty, and flight operations systems remains authoritative unless the charter says otherwise. Build the lakehouse around governed extracts, medallion transformation, and FAA, IATA, PCI, privacy, residency, safety-critical lineage, and operational reconciliation.

The modernization touches IROPs recovery, dynamic pricing, crew legality, fuel, maintenance, and passenger-360 use cases.

patterns.name: Bank connectivity matrix clears before rollout confidence is claimed
patterns.shortDescription: Bank connectivity is a phase-zero readiness gate. Hidden host-to-host, SWIFT, BAI2, EBICS, or portal work can quietly become the longest critical path.
patterns.longDescription:
Bank connectivity is a phase-zero readiness gate. Hidden host-to-host, SWIFT, BAI2, EBICS, or portal work can quietly become the longest critical path.

Do not call Kyriba rollout green until Lakeshore has a bank connectivity matrix that maps every bank account to entity, feed format, payment workflow, signer, connectivity status, implementation owner, and sequencing priority. High-balance and high-payment-volume banks go first; tail banks are contained so they do not stall go-live.

The pattern applies to any Kyriba or TMS rollout where Lakeshore has more than one bank or operating-company cash estate.

It does not apply to a single-bank pilot with no payment workflow or reporting dependency.
observations: Names the bank inventory and connectivity matrix as a Move 0 readiness gate.
Live Move attachment proof includes kyriba-rollout-gate-01-bank-connectivity-matrix.md.
Requires finance/treasury, integration topology, and vendor contract dimensions to reconcile.

patterns.name: Banking consolidation Source event should precede automation of fragmentation
patterns.shortDescription: Treasury modernization should reduce avoidable complexity. Kyriba readiness often exposes a commercial sourcing opportunity around banks, services, fees, and connectivity.
patterns.longDescription:
Treasury modernization should reduce avoidable complexity. Kyriba readiness often exposes a commercial sourcing opportunity around banks, services, fees, and connectivity.

When the bank connectivity matrix shows redundant relationships, high fees, fragmented services, or weak connectivity readiness, Source should evaluate banking consolidation or service rationalization before Kyriba automates the messy estate. The decision fork is containment for go-live versus broader consolidation for value.

The pattern applies when Lakeshore has several banks, overlapping services, and enough implementation runway to evaluate consolidation without blocking critical cash visibility.

It does not apply when a regulatory, customer, trust, or opco constraint requires the bank relationship to remain separate.

The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive in insource versus outsource decision framework. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

The make-buy call is not a rate comparison; it weighs total cost, retained control, clinical or operating risk, capability depth, transition risk, and reversibility. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive and the category is capability depth with specialist provider or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.

patterns.longDescription:

ED Flow, Capacity Command Center & Virtual Nursing patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When Capacity Command Center Worklist Prioritization Human Override Ambiguity appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is exit-rights clause.

patterns.longDescription:
Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H10711 in Revenue Cycle Automation & Denial AI. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.

Revenue Cycle Automation & Denial AI patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When Claim Scrubber Patient Outreach Agent Tool Boundary Failure appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is approval gate.

patterns.longDescription:
Use this when the vendor is bundling advisory, build, and run work into one price in analytics ams market. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

Separate analytics run support from data-product build work; the CPO owns the commercial event and the CDAO owns semantic acceptance. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when the vendor is bundling advisory, build, and run work into one price and the category is clinical analytics with Health Catalyst or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.

patterns.name: Covenant forecasting must run ahead of quarterly tests
patterns.shortDescription: Covenant management is an early-warning discipline. Treasury value includes giving the CFO time to act before covenant pressure becomes a board surprise.
patterns.longDescription:
Covenant management is an early-warning discipline. Treasury value includes giving the CFO time to act before covenant pressure becomes a board surprise.

Treasury and FP&A must forecast covenant headroom at least twelve weeks before test dates, using finance-attested EBITDA, debt, cash, interest, and fixed-charge assumptions. AbarVa should flag projected covenant pressure as a decision item, not bury it in dashboard commentary.

The pattern applies where Lakeshore has debt facilities, covenant tests, acquisition financing, or material credit agreements.

It does not apply to entities with no covenants, no debt, or immaterial facilities not tied to treasury decisions.
observations: Identifies covenant headroom as a treasury pattern and buyer-safe discussion point.
Positions AbarVa as early-warning and value-realization layer over rollout outcomes.

patterns.name: Daily cash pre-walk remains mandatory after Kyriba feeds automate
patterns.shortDescription: Daily cash discipline is a treasury control, not a portal feature. Kyriba improves visibility, but the Treasurer still owns same-day explanation of material variance.
patterns.longDescription:
Daily cash discipline is a treasury control, not a portal feature. Kyriba improves visibility, but the Treasurer still owns same-day explanation of material variance.

The Treasurer must pre-walk the consolidated cash position before relying on dashboard automation. Any cash surprise above five percent or any unexplained high-balance entity movement is reconciled same day and surfaced to the CFO before the next decision forum.

The pattern applies whenever Lakeshore is using Kyriba or a similar TMS for multi-entity cash visibility across the holdco and operating companies.

It does not apply to low-materiality petty-cash balances or archival account cleanup with no operational liquidity impact.
observations: Defines daily cash pre-walk and variance discipline as core treasury doctrine.
Frames value realization and early-warning controls as the buyer-owned success layer.

patterns.name: Entity hierarchy and account registry prevent treasury misclassification
patterns.shortDescription: A diversified holdco cannot rely on casual entity mapping. Treasury, tax, control, and intercompany views must agree before Kyriba becomes a control plane.
patterns.longDescription:
A diversified holdco cannot rely on casual entity mapping. Treasury, tax, control, and intercompany views must agree before Kyriba becomes a control plane.

Load Kyriba only after the canonical registry reconciles legal entity, opco, bank account, signer, currency, purpose, intercompany relationship, and reporting hierarchy. Any mismatch between treasury, tax, corporate secretary, or controller views is a blocker for production reporting.

The pattern applies to Lakeshore's holdco and operating-company structure where one treasury platform spans several legal and operating views.

It does not apply to a sandbox demo using dummy entities with no accounting, payment, or covenant implication.
observations: Names canonical entity and account hierarchy as a Move 0 gate.
Live Move attachment proof includes kyriba-rollout-gate-03-entity-hierarchy-registry.md.

patterns.name: Epic AMS sourcing control for epic ams market and leverage
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history in epic ams market and leverage. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history in epic ams market and leverage. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

Renegotiate Epic AMS around actual service work, named accountability, exit rights, and knowledge transfer; do not renew on inherited ticket categories alone. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history and the category is Epic AMS with Nordic or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

When Epic Cloud Agentic Orchestration Agent Tool Boundary Failure appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is value realization ledger.

patterns.name: ERP feed quality scorecard is the reconciliation gate
patterns.shortDescription: Treasury transformation fails when ERP data quality is discovered late. Feed quality must be scored before reconciliation and forecasting claims are accepted.
patterns.longDescription:
Treasury transformation fails when ERP data quality is discovered late. Feed quality must be scored before reconciliation and forecasting claims are accepted.

Create a feed-quality scorecard for every ERP, AP, AR, GL, and bank-position feed that Kyriba depends on. Each feed gets an owner, timeliness score, completeness score, mapping status, variance tolerance, known defect list, and remediation date before the CFO accepts the program status.

The pattern applies to Lakeshore's multi-opco finance estate where treasury value depends on clean ERP and working-capital data.

It does not apply to a standalone reporting demo that explicitly excludes reconciliation, forecasting, and value proof.
observations: Frames ERP, AP, AR, and GL feeds as required readiness gates.
Live Move attachment proof includes kyriba-rollout-gate-02-erp-feed-quality-scorecard.md.

patterns.name: Escalation path sourcing control for vendor-specific deep dives
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when finance wants a savings number before the category team has evidence in vendor-specific deep dives. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when finance wants a savings number before the category team has evidence in vendor-specific deep dives. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

Vendor deep dives must separate what is public capability, what is contract-specific evidence, and what is account-team behavior observed by the health system. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when finance wants a savings number before the category team has evidence and the category is escalation path with RCM outsourcer or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.

AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

patterns.name: Financial posture sourcing control for vendor-specific deep dives
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when clinical or operational owners disagree with the procurement scorecard in vendor-specific deep dives. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when clinical or operational owners disagree with the procurement scorecard in vendor-specific deep dives. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

Vendor deep dives must separate what is public capability, what is contract-specific evidence, and what is account-team behavior observed by the health system. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when clinical or operational owners disagree with the procurement scorecard and the category is financial posture with Epic services partner or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.

patterns.name: GPO leverage sourcing control for healthcare bpo supply chain doctrine
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history in healthcare bpo supply chain doctrine. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history in healthcare bpo supply chain doctrine. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

A healthcare CPO treats supply-chain value as contract economics plus clinical adoption plus utilization control; price variance alone is not a savings claim. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history and the category is GPO leverage with Vizient or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

patterns.name: Historical cash reconstruction is required before forecasting value claims
patterns.shortDescription: Forecasting value is earned through clean history. AbarVa should distinguish future AI potential from finance-attested cash history.
patterns.longDescription:
Forecasting value is earned through clean history. AbarVa should distinguish future AI potential from finance-attested cash history.

Before claiming forecast improvement, reconstruct historical cash position, bank statement, AR, AP, and working-capital data over a sufficient lookback period. Finance must attest baseline error rates, cycle time, and value assumptions before AbarVa or Kyriba claims AI-enabled improvement.

The pattern applies whenever Lakeshore wants to claim forecasting, liquidity planning, working-capital, or AI value from Kyriba data.

It does not apply to a non-value demo that only shows navigation or workflow state without performance claims.

patterns.longDescription:

patterns.name: Intercompany reconciliation controls are Wave 1, not aftercare
patterns.shortDescription: Intercompany is a treasury control lane. If it stays manual, Kyriba may improve visibility while month-end risk remains untouched.
patterns.longDescription:
Intercompany is a treasury control lane. If it stays manual, Kyriba may improve visibility while month-end risk remains untouched.

Kyriba Wave 1 must include intercompany reconciliation design: lending terms, entity pairings, interest treatment, true-up cadence, posting ownership, exception thresholds, and close-calendar integration. Manual intercompany cleanup after go-live is a risk acceptance decision, not a default.

The pattern applies to holdco treasury programs with operating-company loans, shared cash, or related-party settlements.

It does not apply where Lakeshore has no intercompany balances or the scope is explicitly limited to read-only bank reporting.

Interoperability and Usability evidence should be scored directly, not inferred from architecture diagrams.

Start from 14-32 person-weeks before automation, then adjust for 15-45% automation leverage, residual macro density, PROC semantics, statistical validation, and user acceptance, dual-run, cutover, and decommission. Present P50, P80, and P95 with confidence; never a single exact estimate.
patterns.longDescription:
The inventory classifies SAS analytics workload as large because it has dense logic, high dependencies, or regulated validation. Start from 14-32 person-weeks before automation, then adjust for 15-45% automation leverage, residual macro density, PROC semantics, statistical validation, and user acceptance, dual-run, cutover, and decommission. Present P50, P80, and P95 with confidence; never a single exact estimate.

Start from 14-32 person-weeks before automation, then adjust for 15-45% automation leverage, residual macro density, PROC semantics, statistical validation, and user acceptance, dual-run, cutover, and decommission. Present P50, P80, and P95 with confidence; never a single exact estimate.

The workload inventory includes object count, complexity flags, dependencies, and test/reconciliation scope.

Do not emit P50/P80/P95 when the inventory is missing source type or downstream dependency evidence.
observations: AbarVa modernization research notes — Internal research spine separating source-backed methodology from AbarVa planning heuristics.

patterns.name: Legacy sunset planning control for Epic Clarity reporting mart
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when legacy owner wants the old report certified as the record of truth indefinitely during modernization of a Epic Clarity reporting mart. The CDAO keeps the decision tied to clinical operations and quality reporting, not just platform migration activity.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when legacy owner wants the old report certified as the record of truth indefinitely during modernization of a Epic Clarity reporting mart. The CDAO keeps the decision tied to clinical operations and quality reporting, not just platform migration activity.

Write shutdown criteria before migration begins; otherwise modernization creates a second run-cost stack instead of retiring the old one. The accountable owner must name the funding, run-cost, and shutdown consequence in the same memo.

Applies when legacy owner wants the old report certified as the record of truth indefinitely and the Epic Clarity reporting mart is part of a healthcare modernization wave with PHI lineage and reconciliation.

Does not apply to a pure infrastructure refresh with no data-product, contract, run-cost, shutdown, or clinical/operational decision dependency.

patterns.name: M&A trigger sourcing control for renegotiation triggers and mid-contract optimization
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history in renegotiation triggers and mid-contract optimization. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history in renegotiation triggers and mid-contract optimization. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

A mid-contract trigger is only useful if the CPO can tie it to scope, service levels, volume, controls, or measurable economics; otherwise it is noise. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history and the category is M&A trigger with incumbent vendor or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

patterns.name: Minimum Necessary Capacity Forecasting Criteria Drift doctrine-context hardening
patterns.shortDescription: Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H15004 in Compliance, Privacy, HIPAA & BAA AI Controls. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.
patterns.longDescription:
Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H15004 in Compliance, Privacy, HIPAA & BAA AI Controls. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.

Compliance, Privacy, HIPAA & BAA AI Controls patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When Minimum Necessary Capacity Forecasting Criteria Drift appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is unsafe-to-fund gate.

Applies when Compliance, Privacy, HIPAA & BAA AI Controls initiatives need explicit decision ownership, evidence artifacts, and governed AI-control language before scale funding.

Does not apply when the pattern is only being shown as a raw internal audit reference and will not be retrieved by a user-facing agent.

patterns.name: Model operations sourcing control for analytics ams market
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when finance wants a savings number before the category team has evidence in analytics ams market. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:

patterns.shortDescription: Use this when service levels are green but operating leaders say the work is not improving in renegotiation triggers and mid-contract optimization. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when service levels are green but operating leaders say the work is not improving in renegotiation triggers and mid-contract optimization. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

A mid-contract trigger is only useful if the CPO can tie it to scope, service levels, volume, controls, or measurable economics; otherwise it is noise. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when service levels are green but operating leaders say the work is not improving and the category is modernization milestone with managed-services provider or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.

Use this when clinical or operational owners disagree with the procurement scorecard in cyber and infrastructure managed services. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

sections.title: Summary
sections.body: Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H12575 in Nursing Workforce AI & Staffing Optimization. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.

sections.title: Doctrine
sections.body: Nursing Workforce AI & Staffing Optimization patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When Nursing Staffing AI Drafting Equity Guardrail Drift appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is benefit validation plan.

sections.title: Applies when
sections.body: Applies when Nursing Workforce AI & Staffing Optimization initiatives need explicit decision ownership, evidence artifacts, and governed AI-control language before scale funding.

sections.title: Does not apply when
sections.body: Does not apply when the pattern is only being shown as a raw internal audit reference and will not be retrieved by a user-facing agent.

triggerSymptoms: Existing Nursing Workforce AI & Staffing Optimization pattern lacks explicit doctrine_context fields for persona routing, evidence retrieval, and decision artifact guidance.
nursing staffing AI
CMS CoP
procurement RFP scoring
Salesforce Health Cloud
detectionSignals: Do not leave Nursing Staffing AI Drafting Equity Guardrail Drift as description-only corpus text; a CXO answer will sound plausible but fail to name the owner, evidence, and action gate.
The agent retrieves H12575 but cannot turn it into a board-ready next move because doctrine, artifacts, and exception rules are not explicit.

Nursing Workforce AI & Staffing Optimization initiatives fail when nursing staffing AI is used for drafting but the model performs acceptably in aggregate while underperforming for language, payer, race, rural access, disability, or complex-comorbidity cohorts

Keep the source-of-record boundary explicit: ERP, POS, merchandising master, loyalty, and CDP systems remains authoritative unless the charter says otherwise. Build the lakehouse around governed extracts, medallion transformation, and PCI, CCPA, GDPR, SOX, consent, and customer-identity governance.
patterns.longDescription:
ERP, POS, merchandising master, loyalty, and CDP systems appears in the inventory as both source system and reporting dependency. Keep the source-of-record boundary explicit: ERP, POS, merchandising master, loyalty, and CDP systems remains authoritative unless the charter says otherwise. Build the lakehouse around governed extracts, medallion transformation, and PCI, CCPA, GDPR, SOX, consent, and customer-identity governance.

Keep the source-of-record boundary explicit: ERP, POS, merchandising master, loyalty, and CDP systems remains authoritative unless the charter says otherwise. Build the lakehouse around governed extracts, medallion transformation, and PCI, CCPA, GDPR, SOX, consent, and customer-identity governance.

The modernization touches personalization, demand forecasting, markdown, supply-chain visibility, and store labor use cases.

Do not apply when the charter is a pure reporting cleanup with no source-system integration change.

patterns.name: OMOP Triage Value Ledger Overstatement doctrine-context hardening
patterns.shortDescription: Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H19188 in Academic Medical Center Research AI. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.
patterns.longDescription:
Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H19188 in Academic Medical Center Research AI. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.

Academic Medical Center Research AI patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When OMOP Triage Value Ledger Overstatement appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is unsafe-to-fund gate.

Applies when Academic Medical Center Research AI initiatives need explicit decision ownership, evidence artifacts, and governed AI-control language before scale funding.

Does not apply when the pattern is only being shown as a raw internal audit reference and will not be retrieved by a user-facing agent.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines Wave 4 as a dom31-dom80 healthcare corpus audit and doctrine-context hardening wave.
Healthcare harden substrate-alignment addendum v2 — Addendum requires Wave 4 audit verdicts to consider both legacy classification fields and the new doctrine_context substrate.
Authored healthcare genome seed files — Local authored healthcare domain seed files supply the existing pattern codes and descriptions used in the Wave 4 audit sample.

patterns.name: Optimization backlog sourcing control for epic ams market and leverage
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive in epic ams market and leverage. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive in epic ams market and leverage. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

Renegotiate Epic AMS around actual service work, named accountability, exit rights, and knowledge transfer; do not renew on inherited ticket categories alone. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive and the category is optimization backlog with Cognizant TriZetto or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

patterns.longDescription:
Payment controls are not a checklist after go-live. They are acceptance criteria for treasury workflow safety.

Before Kyriba payment workflows are accepted, Lakeshore must test segregation of duties, first-time payee callback, approval thresholds, signer authority, emergency-payment process, BEC escalation, and audit logging. Exceptions require named risk acceptance by CFO or Controller.

The pattern applies whenever Kyriba or connected banks initiate, approve, release, or report payments.

It does not apply to read-only bank balance feeds with no payment initiation or approval function.

patterns.name: Procurement governance sourcing control for cpo operating doctrine
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive in cpo operating doctrine. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive in cpo operating doctrine. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

The CPO operating model must distinguish negotiated savings, validated savings, avoided cost, and service-level protection; each needs a CFO-visible evidence trail. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive and the category is procurement governance with GPO partner or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H11224 in Agentic Care Navigation & Transitions. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.

Agentic Care Navigation & Transitions patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When Readmission Risk Quality Abstraction Workflow Authority Gap appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is FHIR R4 mapping.

patterns.name: Regulatory change sourcing control for renegotiation triggers and mid-contract optimization
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when data, PHI, or security controls are embedded in the service in renegotiation triggers and mid-contract optimization. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when data, PHI, or security controls are embedded in the service in renegotiation triggers and mid-contract optimization. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

A mid-contract trigger is only useful if the CPO can tie it to scope, service levels, volume, controls, or measurable economics; otherwise it is noise. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when data, PHI, or security controls are embedded in the service and the category is regulatory change with incumbent vendor or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when vendor scope changed after modernization but the statement of work did not in renegotiation triggers and mid-contract optimization. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

A mid-contract trigger is only useful if the CPO can tie it to scope, service levels, volume, controls, or measurable economics; otherwise it is noise. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when vendor scope changed after modernization but the statement of work did not and the category is regulatory change with BPO partner or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.

patterns.name: Reliability weighted scorecard question for SI selection
patterns.shortDescription: The CDAO needs to score multiple modernization bids with different price and risk postures. Weight architecture fit, automation method, normalized TCO, delivery risk, team model, governance and security, phasing, and AI enablement. Reliability evidence should be scored directly, not inferred from architecture diagrams.
patterns.longDescription:

patterns.name: relocate disposition decision rule for DataStage ETL job family
patterns.shortDescription: A workload owner proposes relocate for DataStage ETL job family during inventory rationalization. Record why a cheaper or more transformative R was rejected, because disposition is the largest effort multiplier in the SI bid.

patterns.name: Renewal pressure sourcing control for vendor-specific deep dives
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive in vendor-specific deep dives. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive in vendor-specific deep dives. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

Vendor deep dives must separate what is public capability, what is contract-specific evidence, and what is account-team behavior observed by the health system. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when transition risk is being waved away because the rate card looks attractive and the category is renewal pressure with RCM outsourcer or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

When Risk Adjustment Agentic Orchestration Value Ledger Overstatement appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is decision evidence.

sections.title: Applies when
sections.body: Applies when Value-Based Contracting & Actuarial AI initiatives need explicit decision ownership, evidence artifacts, and governed AI-control language before scale funding.

sections.title: Does not apply when
sections.body: Does not apply when the pattern is only being shown as a raw internal audit reference and will not be retrieved by a user-facing agent.

triggerSymptoms: Existing Value-Based Contracting & Actuarial AI pattern lacks explicit doctrine_context fields for persona routing, evidence retrieval, and decision artifact guidance.
risk adjustment
MCO contract

clinical advisory board

patterns.name: Risk profile sourcing control for vendor-specific deep dives
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when service levels are green but operating leaders say the work is not improving in vendor-specific deep dives. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when service levels are green but operating leaders say the work is not improving in vendor-specific deep dives. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

Vendor deep dives must separate what is public capability, what is contract-specific evidence, and what is account-team behavior observed by the health system. When Rural Health Eligibility Prediction Adoption Telemetry Missing appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is adoption plan.

patterns.name: SAS analytics workload automation range and residual work rule
patterns.shortDescription: A bidder quotes a single automation percentage for SAS analytics workload. Use 15-45% as a planning range, not a guaranteed conversion yield. The CDAO should ask the SI to show Analyzer evidence, residual macro density, PROC semantics, statistical validation, and user acceptance, and how residual work changes P50/P80/P95 effort.
patterns.longDescription:
A bidder quotes a single automation percentage for SAS analytics workload. Use 15-45% as a planning range, not a guaranteed conversion yield. The CDAO should ask the SI to show Analyzer evidence, residual macro density, PROC semantics, statistical validation, and user acceptance, and how residual work changes P50/P80/P95 effort.

Use 15-45% as a planning range, not a guaranteed conversion yield. The CDAO should ask the SI to show Analyzer evidence, residual macro density, PROC semantics, statistical validation, and user acceptance, and how residual work changes P50/P80/P95 effort.

Lakebridge or equivalent Analyzer inventory exists or can be requested before BAFO.

Do not use this range as a quote when source exports, code samples, and reconciliation targets are unavailable.
observations: Databricks Lakebridge overview — Lakebridge covers survey, assessment, SQL translation, and reconciliation across migration phases.
Databricks Lakebridge Analyzer documentation — Lakebridge Analyzer scans ETL and SQL metadata and feeds metrics into conversion and engineering-hour estimates.

patterns.name: SAS analytics workload disposition doctrine for omnichannel retail
patterns.shortDescription: An omnichannel retail modernization inventory shows SAS analytics workload objects with regulated downstream use. Classify SAS analytics workload as re-architect unless Analyzer evidence proves lower-risk treatment. Target PySpark, SQL, ML, or governed notebook workload; treat macro density, PROC semantics, statistical validation, and user acceptance as manual residual, not as conversion-tool failure.
patterns.longDescription:
An omnichannel retail modernization inventory shows SAS analytics workload objects with regulated downstream use. Classify SAS analytics workload as re-architect unless Analyzer evidence proves lower-risk treatment. Target PySpark, SQL, ML, or governed notebook workload; treat macro density, PROC semantics, statistical validation, and user acceptance as manual residual, not as conversion-tool failure.

Classify SAS analytics workload as re-architect unless Analyzer evidence proves lower-risk treatment. Target PySpark, SQL, ML, or governed notebook workload; treat macro density, PROC semantics, statistical validation, and user acceptance as manual residual, not as conversion-tool failure.

The workload feeds personalization, demand forecasting, markdown, supply-chain visibility, and store labor use cases or must survive a production dual-run period.

Do not apply when usage evidence shows the workload should be retired before conversion.
observations: Databricks Lakebridge Analyzer documentation — Lakebridge Analyzer scans ETL and SQL metadata and feeds metrics into conversion and engineering-hour estimates.

The make-buy call is not a rate comparison; it weighs total cost, retained control, clinical or operating risk, capability depth, transition risk, and reversibility. patterns.name: SI scope change control protects the buyer during implementation
patterns.shortDescription: Implementation partner status is not buyer truth. AbarVa keeps scope, acceptance, and value gates visible so Lakeshore can manage the SI without running the SI's project.
patterns.longDescription:
Implementation partner status is not buyer truth. AbarVa keeps scope, acceptance, and value gates visible so Lakeshore can manage the SI without running the SI's project.

Every Kyriba SI milestone should have a buyer-owned outcome, acceptance evidence, change-control rule, and escalation owner. Scope additions, data migration deferrals, customization decisions, and training reductions require explicit CFO/CIO decision rather than informal project-team drift.

The pattern applies when Lakeshore uses an external implementation partner for Kyriba or any major finance platform rollout.

It does not apply to internal-only configuration changes with no vendor milestone, scope, or acceptance implication.

patterns.name: small SAS analytics workload P50 P80 P95 effort band

Present P50, P80, and P95 with confidence; never a single exact estimate.

patterns.name: SNF Triage Workflow Authority Gap doctrine-context hardening
patterns.shortDescription: Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H15782 in Home Health & Post-Acute Agentic Workflows. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.
patterns.longDescription:
Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H15782 in Home Health & Post-Acute Agentic Workflows. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.

Home Health & Post-Acute Agentic Workflows patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When SNF Triage Workflow Authority Gap appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is BAFO contract clause.

Applies when Home Health & Post-Acute Agentic Workflows initiatives need explicit decision ownership, evidence artifacts, and governed AI-control language before scale funding.

Does not apply when the pattern is only being shown as a raw internal audit reference and will not be retrieved by a user-facing agent.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines Wave 4 as a dom31-dom80 healthcare corpus audit and doctrine-context hardening wave.
Healthcare harden substrate-alignment addendum v2 — Addendum requires Wave 4 audit verdicts to consider both legacy classification fields and the new doctrine_context substrate.
Authored healthcare genome seed files — Local authored healthcare domain seed files supply the existing pattern codes and descriptions used in the Wave 4 audit sample.
HIPAA security and privacy obligations — Healthcare AI patterns involving PHI, vendors, subprocessors, and audit evidence must preserve privacy, security, and business-associate control discipline.

Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H12239 in Pharmacy AI, Medication Safety & 340B. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.

Pharmacy AI, Medication Safety & 340B patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When Split Billing Risk Scoring Integration Surface Fragmentation appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. patterns.name: SQL Server stored procedure family disposition doctrine for airline operations
patterns.shortDescription: An airline operations modernization inventory shows SQL Server stored procedure family objects with regulated downstream use. Classify SQL Server stored procedure family as rationalize and refactor unless Analyzer evidence proves lower-risk treatment. Target silver and gold Spark SQL or PySpark logic; treat T-SQL idioms, cursors, temp tables, semantic tests, and performance rewrite as manual residual, not as conversion-tool failure.

An airline operations modernization inventory shows SQL Server stored procedure family objects with regulated downstream use. Classify SQL Server stored procedure family as rationalize and refactor unless Analyzer evidence proves lower-risk treatment. Target silver and gold Spark SQL or PySpark logic; treat T-SQL idioms, cursors, temp tables, semantic tests, and performance rewrite as manual residual, not as conversion-tool failure.

Classify SQL Server stored procedure family as rationalize and refactor unless Analyzer evidence proves lower-risk treatment. Target silver and gold Spark SQL or PySpark logic; treat T-SQL idioms, cursors, temp tables, semantic tests, and performance rewrite as manual residual, not as conversion-tool failure.

The workload feeds IROPs recovery, dynamic pricing, crew legality, fuel, maintenance, and passenger-360 use cases or must survive a production dual-run period.

Do not apply when usage evidence shows the workload should be retired before conversion.

patterns.name: Task Automation Triage Revenue Integrity Leakage doctrine-context hardening
patterns.shortDescription: Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H17266 in Agentic AI: Administrative Copilots. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.
patterns.longDescription:
Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H17266 in Agentic AI: Administrative Copilots. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.

Agentic AI: Administrative Copilots patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When Task Automation Triage Revenue Integrity Leakage appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is adoption plan.

Applies when Agentic AI: Administrative Copilots initiatives need explicit decision ownership, evidence artifacts, and governed AI-control language before scale funding.

Does not apply when the pattern is only being shown as a raw internal audit reference and will not be retrieved by a user-facing agent.

Healthcare harden substrate-alignment addendum v2 — Addendum requires Wave 4 audit verdicts to consider both legacy classification fields and the new doctrine_context substrate.
Authored healthcare genome seed files — Local authored healthcare domain seed files supply the existing pattern codes and descriptions used in the Wave 4 audit sample.
HIPAA security and privacy obligations — Healthcare AI patterns involving PHI, vendors, subprocessors, and audit evidence must preserve privacy, security, and business-associate control discipline.

patterns.name: TCO sourcing control for insource versus outsource decision framework
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history in insource versus outsource decision framework. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history in insource versus outsource decision framework. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

The make-buy call is not a rate comparison; it weighs total cost, retained control, clinical or operating risk, capability depth, transition risk, and reversibility. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when renewal is approaching and the incumbent is relying on relationship history and the category is TCO with incumbent outsourcer or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

patterns.name: Transition cost sourcing control for insource versus outsource decision framework
patterns.shortDescription: Use this when clinical or operational owners disagree with the procurement scorecard in insource versus outsource decision framework. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.
patterns.longDescription:
Use this when clinical or operational owners disagree with the procurement scorecard in insource versus outsource decision framework. The sourcing answer should help a healthcare CPO defend value, risk, controls, and transition readiness in front of finance and operating leaders.

The make-buy call is not a rate comparison; it weighs total cost, retained control, clinical or operating risk, capability depth, transition risk, and reversibility. In this scenario, the CPO must define the evidence request, the commercial lever, the operating acceptance owner, and the post-award control before moving to BAFO.

Applies when clinical or operational owners disagree with the procurement scorecard and the category is transition cost with platform-native team or an equivalent provider in scope.

Does not apply to a low-risk commodity purchase with no PHI, clinical, operational, transition, vendor-lock, or CFO savings validation exposure.
observations: Healthcare modernization and CPO hardening execution brief — Execution brief defines the healthcare CPO domains, category families, vendor examples, and operating bar for sourcing-event answers.
AbarVa healthcare CDAO Wave 2 corpus pack — Wave 2 established CDAO modernization charter rules that CPO sourcing patterns must align with during modernization-triggered renegotiations.

Healthcare sourcing operator doctrine — Brief requires CPO patterns to be defensible by a healthcare procurement operator and tied to evidence, category ownership, BAFO, TCO, and cross-CXO governance.

patterns.longDescription:
Backfills rich doctrine_context for existing healthcare pattern H16271 in Startup Ecosystem: RCM & Coding Vendor Diligence. The refinement preserves the original failure signal while making the pattern usable for CXO-grade retrieval, sourcing, and modernization decisions.

Startup Ecosystem: RCM & Coding Vendor Diligence patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When Waystar Vendor Comparison Revenue Integrity Leakage appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is value realization ledger.

Applies when Startup Ecosystem: RCM & Coding Vendor Diligence initiatives need explicit decision ownership, evidence artifacts, and governed AI-control language before scale funding.

Does not apply when the pattern is only being shown as a raw internal audit reference and will not be retrieved by a user-facing agent.

sections.body: Startup Ecosystem: RCM & Coding Vendor Diligence patterns must be treated as funded-decision controls, not idea inventory. When Waystar Vendor Comparison Revenue Integrity Leakage appears in an initiative, the responsible CXO should require a named owner, a measurable evidence artifact, a vendor or workflow control, and a no-scale condition before approving expansion. The practical control is value realization ledger.

sections.title: Applies when

sections.title: Does not apply when
sections.body: Does not apply when the pattern is only being shown as a raw internal audit reference and will not be retrieved by a user-facing agent.

Rank workloads by business value, technical complexity, source readiness, clinical or operating risk, and shutdown leverage rather than by whoever shouts loudest. The gate only advances when CMIO and the accountable operator accept the evidence.
